reference.spectrum: H=K Qe-K Qo+2B. For r>0: energies K (rank2), -K+/-2r with Q+/-=(Qo+/-B/r)/2. At K=+r merge Qe with Q+; at K=-r merge Qe with Q-. At r=0: K Qe-K Qo; K=0 gives sole projector I.
reference.dynamics: For r>0 psi(t)=exp(iKt)[(cos(2rt)-i Delta sin(2rt)/r)|01>-i J sin(2rt)/r |10>]. For r=0: exp(iKt)|01>. p=J^2 sin^2(2rt)/r^2. If J=0, p=0 always and earliest maximizing time0; otherwise supremum J^2/r^2 and earliest maximizing time pi/(4r).
reference.pure_state: rho1=diag(1-p,p); S=-p log2 p-(1-p)log2(1-p), endpoint0log0=0; C=2sqrt(p(1-p)); CHSHmax=2sqrt(1+C^2) with correlation-matrix/measurement derivation required. Maximal entanglement iff J!=0 and |J|>=|Delta|; first time arcsin(r/(sqrt(2)|J|))/(2r).
reference.thermal: For r>0 set c=cosh(2 beta r),s=sinh(2 beta r),Z=2 exp(-beta K)+2 exp(beta K)c. Gibbs diagonal u,v,w,u with u=exp(-beta K)/Z,v=exp(beta K)(c-Delta s/r)/Z,w=exp(beta K)(c+Delta s/r)/Z and off-diagonal z=-exp(beta K)J s/(rZ) only between01,10. PT eigenvalues v,w,u+/-|z|. Entangled iff exp(2 beta K)|J|s/r>1; equality separable. beta0 gives I/4. r0 gives diag(exp(-beta K),exp(beta K),exp(beta K),exp(-beta K))/(4 cosh(beta K)), separable.
